companyDescription: NDAA-compliant US drone components + FPV drones · Q3 2026 revenue $13.9M (+551% y/y) with a reaffirmed $25M Q4 target · Drone Dominance Phase 2 orders placed, Phase 3 funded for early 2027 · ~$260M cash + short-term investments vs a ~$485M market cap
priceNote: Live $9.71 (-3.29%) on Nov 18, 2026 (live-prices cache). Down ~50% from $19.53 at the Jul 22 report and ~42% in the past month (GuruFocus, Nov 13). The drop followed the Nov 5 Q3 print, where a GAAP miss came from investment markdowns, plus PT cuts (Needham $40→$22) and a sector-wide drone selloff (Nov 16). 52-week range $7.24–$34.93.
summary: Survival-first #1 this run. UMAC holds ~$162M cash plus $98.4M short-term investments (Sep 30) against a ~$485M market cap, and Q3 revenue rose 551% y/y to $13.9M with the $25M Q4 target reaffirmed. The stock has still halved since July on a GAAP miss (non-cash markdowns), PT cuts and the Nov 16 drone-sector selloff. The upside path is Q4 delivery (reported ~Mar 2027) plus Drone Dominance Phase 3 orders funded for early 2027. Base +55% is a 3–4 month horizon, not a 30-day call (turbo Base bias +52.5pp vs realized 30d P75 +21.5%). The turbo at-catalyst median is -6.6% (n=76), so Entry 2 is preferred. แนะนำ 2–3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 35–50%.

catalysts.name: Q4 2026 delivery vs the $25M revenue target
catalysts.description: Management reaffirmed a $25M Q4 revenue target on the Nov 5 call and called the risk operational, not demand. Q4 results are expected ~early March 2027 (no date announced). Hitting $25M would put the run-rate near $100M/yr against a ~$485M cap.

catalysts.name: Drone Dominance Phase 3 orders
catalysts.description: Drone Dominance Phase 2 orders were placed in October. Phase 3 is reported as funded for early 2027, but sources conflict on whether UMAC's current allocations include it. A Phase 3 allocation is the order-flow catalyst for the Bull case.

catalysts.name: Powerus $16.9M counter-drone order — shipments
catalysts.description: A $16.9M order from counter-drone partner Powerus was announced with Q3. Shipments feed the Q4 number. Management says current demand supports production through Q1 2027 without new budget initiatives.

risks: Execution risk on the $25M Q4 target. Management framed it as operational (supply/production), and a miss would land on a stock that has already de-rated ~50% on doubt.

Policy dependence: Drone Dominance Phase 3 is funded for early 2027 per one source, but another says UMAC's allocations don't include it yet. A Democratic Congress and continuing-resolution risk could slow new DoD drone money.
GAAP losses are noisy: Q3 diluted EPS was -$0.50, driven by an $18.4M unrealized loss on short-term investments. Investment-portfolio markdowns can repeat.
Analyst targets are falling (Needham $40→$22, Piper Sandler to $29). If the story breaks, consensus could compress toward the price.
High-beta sector: drone names moved together on Nov 16 (ONDS -8%, RCAT -5%, UMAC -4%) despite company-specific news. Macro is WAIT (30/100) with VIX ~23–26.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp. Waller has floated 50bp; Williams pushed back.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI ran hot (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2%). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: High-beta small-cap defense tech. Rate hikes compress long-duration growth multiples, and the drone basket is trading as one factor (Nov 16 selloff). A DoD continuing resolution would delay new program money.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — macro verdict is WAIT (30/100): the S&P sits on its 200-day at a 5-month low with VIX ~23–26. High-beta small caps take the first hit if Oct PCE is hot, so scale in only on dips.

postWin.note: UMAC jumped ~65% in one session on the 2026 WSJ report of Pentagon equity/debt-stake talks with domestic drone makers. A clean Q4 + Phase 3 allocation is a smaller, earnings-backed version of that move.

postLose.note: AVAV fell ~18% over 30 days on a guidance cut after a $1.7B contract termination (Jun 2026). UMAC itself fell ~42% in the month to Nov 13, 2026 on PT cuts and the post-Q3 selloff.
